sources.title: Rabbitty beta README
sources.locator: Download; What it does; Channels; source-private notice
sources.finding: The repository hosts downloads, releases and issues; implementation is private. Public beta builds target macOS 13+ on Intel and Apple Silicon. Worklanes show agent state and notifications.

sources.title: Rabbitty website
sources.locator: Worktrees; Panels & tools; Agent tools; From your phone; free beta
sources.finding: The site documents unmodified local coding CLIs, worktrees, diff review, commits, GitHub/GitLab PR and Jira panels, managed browser and dev-server tools, encrypted paired-phone access and free beta access.

sources.title: Getting started
sources.finding: Open a local project folder, choose an installed agent, create a worktree for an opening prompt, and run several agent terminals concurrently. The sidebar, menu bar and native notifications show working, finished or attention states.

sources.title: Configuration
sources.locator: settings.json; telemetry; worktree_dangerous; activity_log; phone_link; push_url
sources.finding: The telemetry setting defaults true and sends app-launch, agent-startup and state-transition events. The documented switch is the settings JSON boolean. Worktree permission bypass and phone linking default false. Release builds exclude the complete local development activity log.

sources.title: From your phone
sources.locator: Opening sentence; Keeping the Mac awake; From a shell instead
sources.finding: The opening says agents continue after closing the laptop, but the detailed section says a closed lid sleeps regardless and requires an always-open host. Paired phone access reads terminals, sends replies/photos and wraps up worktrees. rab exposes attention, read, send, attach and doctor.

sources.title: Updates and channels
sources.finding: Beta is publicly downloadable; stable is coming soon. The updater checks on launch and from the menu, verifies Apple notarization, replaces the app and relaunches.

sources.title: Beta.73 release notes
sources.finding: ⌘⇧T opens a terminal in the home directory.

sources.title: Beta.72 release notes
sources.finding: Adds Claude ACP mode and model-switch tracking; wrap-up shows worktree-removal progress.

sources.title: Beta.71 release notes
sources.finding: Spaces has merge-to-main and delete-worktree actions; removing a worktree closes every terminal inside it.

sources.title: Beta.70 release notes
sources.finding: Session rename, project worktree actions, working-tree diffstat and Changes panel.

sources.title: Beta.69 release notes
sources.finding: Chat view reads the agent transcript beside a terminal; live input still uses the terminal.

sources.title: Beta.64 release notes
sources.finding: Local project-scoped memory is exposed through MCP; review, approve, reject and archive memory/procedures; unfinished tabs resume exact conversations and Claude transcripts have local search and token/cache metrics.

sources.title: Beta.73 original macOS ZIP
sources.finding: Archive inspection found rabbitty, rabbitty-browser-mcp, rabbitty-term-mcp, rabbitty-hook and a menu-bar helper as native Mach-O executables. Plist declares macOS minimum 13.0. No readable JavaScript/ASAR or source implementation accompanies these binaries. The executables were not run.
